name: Apply Wall Finish (Spray, No Backroll)
intent: Spray the wall field without a backroll pass. Used only at QT2 economy and as a QT3 fallback when crew capacity doesn't allow a backroller. Faster than spray+backroll but produces a more textured laydown that won't pass QT4+ inspection. Cut-in to trim is handled by the standalone MOD_APPLY_CUTIN_TRIM module which fires in parallel (brush work).
doctrine: Single-pass spray rate (650 SF/hr) is roughly 1.6x the spray+backroll rate because there's no backroller bottleneck. Only included by QT2 and QT3 spray-only scenarios. QT4 and QT5 require a backroll pass — if a project specifies spray only at QT4+, the scenario should refuse to match and surface a warning.
